title: Roamhaven Rewards Tier Requirements Chart
content:
Roamhaven Rewards has six tiers. A member reaches a tier for a qualification period by meeting **either** the tier's qualifying-nights figure **or** its completed-stays figure; the two figures are alternatives, and meeting one of them is enough.

| Tier | Qualifying nights | or completed stays |
|---|---|---|
| Rewards Member | 0 | 0 |
| Rewards Silver | 7 | 3 |
| Rewards Gold | 20 | 8 |
| Rewards Platinum | 40 | 15 |
| Rewards Diamond | 75 | 25 |
| Rewards Ambassador | 120 | 40 |

## Counting terms (identical on every tier)

| Term | Value for all six tiers |
|---|---|
| Qualification period | The calendar year, counted by the check-out date of completed stays |
| Nights that count | Nights actually stayed on completed stays and on stays cancelled after check-in |
| Tier on enrollment | Rewards Member |
| Matching another programme's status | Not allowed |

## Notes on reading the chart

- A stay belongs to the qualification period in which its check-out date falls, so all of its nights are counted in that calendar year.
- Only nights actually stayed count. On a stay cancelled after check-in, the nights the guest actually stayed are counted.
- Every new member starts in Rewards Member; a status held in another loyalty programme is not matched to a Roamhaven Rewards tier.

## Worked readings (hypothetical counts)

| Nights counted in the year | Completed stays in the year | Rewards Silver met? | Rewards Gold met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | 2 | No (below 7 nights and below 3 stays) | No |
| 7 | 1 | Yes, by nights | No |
| 4 | 3 | Yes, by stays | No |
| 19 | 8 | Yes | Yes, by stays (8 stays), although nights are one short of 20 |
| 20 | 2 | Yes | Yes, by nights |

A hypothetical stay checked in on 29 December and checked out on 2 January is counted, with all of its nights, in the calendar year of 2 January.
